value.message: Town of Oakville has Preschool A Learn to Swim, Saturdays 9:00-9:30am, Sept 12 to Nov 28, for ages 3-5 (no parent in water) - their site says. Fees are set by Council and published in the current Recreation Guide. Fall registration opens Tue Aug 11 at 7am for residents; options browsable online from Aug 4. I couldn't pin down the exact fee - I'll keep watching and text you once it's posted.
